senses.sense_definition: A prisoner in a Nazi concentration camp who was given special duties and privileges.

examples.text: The <w>prominents</w> were treated differently from the other inmates.

target_lang_translations.fr: Les <w>prominents</w> étaient traités différemment des autres détenus.
target_lang_translations.nl: De <w>prominenten</w> werden anders behandeld dan de andere gevangenen.
